Definition: Shalem, an early name of Jerusalem
BiblicalUsage: Salem is the old name of Jerusalem, and it is where Melchizedek ruled as king and priest of the most high God. He brought forth bread and wine to Abram after the battle with the kings, and the psalm says that in Salem also is God's tabernacle, and His dwelling place in Zion.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Salem is where peace and priesthood met before Jerusalem had a wall, and Melchizedek's bread and wine point straight to Christ.
